editor.notes: Map sandbox world (see apps/sandbox_map). meadow and cave: ground is elevation 3, the plateau 4, the stairs 0 (any level). showcase (built with capsule-studio's core; see README, Test apps): every map feature at once; its plateaus are elevation 5 (sprite priority 1, over the bridge deck). Encounters (D-12): species from the battle sandbox's invented data; showcase grass west of x 24 is slot 0, east is slot 1 (night-only creatures); the meadow uses the shared table meadow_grass. A toggles night in the sandbox. Events (B-3): the showcase has a sign north of the start (read facing up), a welcome trigger one step south, a hidden berry at 12,10, a step warp at its west edge (0,9) to the cave and a press warp at its east edge (39,9, press right) to the meadow, which warps back from 0,0 (press left). The cave is in the showcase's area. Step hook pedometer: every 16 steps. Objects (B-21): a guide in the plaza (talk: opens the gate), a stroller wandering east of it, a sentry pacing between the hedges, a rival on the path facing west (sight 4; after the 'battle' it has another line) and a gatekeeper on the meadow exit until the guide is talked to. Eventing (D-17): locations park, meadow and cave with name banners (a box, a wooden sign) and the cave's first-visit preview; the cave warp uses a mosaic, the meadow warps wipe. Field rules (A1/A2): the levels are written out (the default rule, level 5 at priority 1); vehicle class swim (the sandbox menu's vehicle row) crosses water at 2 pixels a frame and cannot run. F2 (D-27 section 3): swim enters only water and dismounts onto land (the Starter's wade action starts it); object kind bush (the showcase's bush at 12,9: the clear action), map tag dark (the cave: darkness 3, the light action), escape points on the showcase and the meadow (going into the cave records one), flight points park, meadow and cave_mouth (recorded on entering their maps; the sandbox menu's flight menu). C8: the darkness levels are the world's (darkness_levels: the Starter's / sandbox's lit box half sizes 72 / 56 / 40 / 24 pixels with brightness 6 / 10 / 13 / 16, the map compiler's defaults); a script-set level (the light action's `darkness 0;`) is kept across a save until the next map. DS1 (D-30): the hut in the showcase's south-east corner: door:HUT bound by the metatile hut_door (the warp sequence opens it, the walker walks in, it closes; leaving the hut it shows open, the walker walks out, it closes); map hut its inside; the default draw-order rule (lower on screen in front).
